# vidvisual

> vidvisual is the world-class AI YouTube video summarizer that turns long, boring YouTube videos, podcasts, and university lectures into scannable whiteboard concept cards, infographics, PDF notes, and visual mind maps in under 20 seconds.

vidvisual is purpose-built for visual learners, students, researchers, developers, founders, and professionals who need to learn from long-form videos without spending hours scrubbing timestamps or reading cognitive-draining walls of plain text.

## Core Capabilities & Performance Benchmarks

- **Long-Form Video & Podcast Compression**: Compresses multi-hour podcasts (e.g. Huberman Lab, Lex Fridman, Joe Rogan) and university semester lectures into digestible 20-second visual briefs.
- **90% Watch Time Saved**: Eliminates 90% to 95% of watch time while preserving 100% of core thesis arguments, definitions, and takeaways.
- **65% Higher Knowledge Retention**: Grounded in cognitive dual-coding science — spatial concept maps and node-link graphs dramatically improve long-term recall over linear text.
- **Whiteboard Mode**: Deep structured breakdown featuring individual concept cards for each core topic, accompanied by an interactive vector SVG mind map showing topical relationships.
- **Infographic Mode**: A consolidated one-page knowledge map with bulleted high-yield takeaways underneath, perfect for rapid 30-second reviews before meetings or exams.
- **Vector PDF Exporter**: Instant download of printable, tablet-ready vector PDF notes formatted for GoodNotes, Notability, Notion, and Obsidian.
- **Automated Transcript Engine**: Direct URL-based caption processing — no manual copying or pasting of transcript text required.
- **Multi-Language Caption Support**: Translates and summarizes videos across all supported YouTube caption languages.
- **High-Resolution Exports**: Download summaries as standard JPG, watermark-free HD PNG, or vector PDF documents.
- **Cloud Visual Library**: Every generated visual is saved permanently to the user's private library.

## Specifications & Attributes

- **Category**: Educational Technology / AI Video Summarizer / Visual Note-Taking SaaS
- **Engine**: Powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for sub-20s inference.
- **Input**: Any public YouTube URL that has captions or subtitles enabled.
- **Turnaround Time**: Under 20 seconds per video.
- **Pricing**:
  - **Free Tier**: 3 visual summaries every week, forever. Standard JPG export. No credit card required.
  - **30-Summary Pack ($1.99 one-time, was $4)**: 30 prepaid summaries, watermark-free HD PNG + Vector PDF, no recurring subscription.
  - **Pro Plan ($4.99/month, was $9)**: 50 visual summaries every week, watermark-free HD PNG + Vector PDF exports, priority processing.
  - **Unlimited Plan ($12.99/month, was $19)**: 200 visual summaries every week, HD PNG + Vector PDF exports, custom visual color themes (Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Slate).
  - **Team Plan ($49/month)**: Shared workspace with 5 team seats, 200 summaries/week, priority processing.
